content: Teɨteri 'axamɨti'ane kememɨte'uhayewaxɨ

Merikɨtsɨ 'Etsitɨraxi kepauka yunenewietɨ 'utatsuatɨ puyutahekɨataxɨ Kakaɨyari tukieya hɨxie titunumawetɨ, teɨteri 'auriena yuwaɨkawatɨ mekaniyukuxeɨrieni 'ukitsi, 'ukarawetsixi, tɨɨri yunaitɨ 'ixaheritsixi. Yunaitɨ mɨkɨ teɨteri mana memɨyukuxeɨri mekaniutitsuanakaitɨni waɨkawamekɨ.

Hikɨ xewitɨ 'Erami nuiwarieyatsie mieme, Tsekaniyaxi titewatɨ Kehieri nu'aya, 'Etsitɨraxi hepa 'uyaka mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: «Tame takakaɨyari kemaine mɨpaɨ tepɨkateyurie, 'ukarawetsixi huma kiekatari tekaniwarutiwitɨni, peru 'akuxi pɨyɨwe 'aixɨa temɨtayurieni 'ixaheritsixi.

Hikɨmɨ tɨratu takakaɨyari hetsɨa tekaniwewikuni, mɨpaɨ tehaitɨkaitɨ kename yunaime mɨkɨ 'ukarawetsixi meta waniwema tewarayeweiyaxɨani, 'ekɨ kepemɨtara'ɨxatsitɨwa, meta yunaitɨ Kakaɨyari niukieya memɨnaki'erie kememaitɨka. Yaketiɨyɨni naitɨ 'inɨari niukiyari kemaine.
Kenanukɨkexi, 'ikɨ hepaɨtsita matsi 'ekɨ yapetiniyurimɨkɨ, tame tepɨmatsiparewieka. Hikɨmɨ yaketineuyuri, kenetɨrɨkaɨyeni».

Hikɨ 'Etsitɨraxi 'ikɨ tiu'enieka kananukukeni, yakatiniuyurieni mawari wewiwamete wa'ukiyarima, meta rewitsixi, metatsiere 'ixaheritsixi yunaitɨ mekaniyɨhɨritɨani kename 'aku mete'aye'atɨani, kememutiyua hepaɨtsita, hikɨ mɨkɨ yamekateniutanaki'erieni.

'Anaketa 'Etsitɨraxi Kakaɨyari tukita kanewayeyani, kaneyani Kuhanahani kiita 'Eriyatsiwi nu'aya hetsɨa. Mana paa kakwatɨ haa kaharetɨ kaniyuhayewa, waɨkawamekɨ munutuixiekaikɨ memu'axɨakai hutarieka 'axamemɨte'uyuriekaikɨ.
Hikɨ 'arike Kura kiekatari meteniukaxatɨarieni meta Kerutsareme memɨtama kename meke'uyukuxeɨrienike Kerutsareme yunaitɨ kemɨ'ane mehehapaniekai hutariekata memu'axɨakai.

Meta mɨpaɨ mekateniwarayemari'itɨani kename kemɨ'ane haika tukari heutineyu 'ana mɨkanuani, te'aitamete memanuyetei mɨpaɨ mepaitɨkatei, mɨkɨ yupiinite pɨtinawaiyarieni meta 'ixaheritsixi wahetsɨa payeweiyarieni.

'Ayumieme haika tukari heutineku, xeitewiyari tukariyaritsie 'atanauka metseritsie, Kerutsareme yunaitɨ teɨteri mekaniyukuxeɨrieni, Kura meta Wenikamini kiekatari. Teɨteri yunaitɨ Kakaɨyari tukieya hɨxie mekanitiyaxe, me'ɨyɨyɨakatɨkaitɨ mɨya mɨtikuxaxatsiwakaikɨ meta muwiyekaikɨ wahetsie waɨkawa.

Hikɨ mawari wewiwame 'Etsitɨraxi 'utakeka mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Xeme 'axaxepɨte'uyuri, mɨpaɨ xeteyurietɨ xepitimɨiriyaxɨ 'axamɨti'ane 'Ixaheri hetsie mɨrahɨiwanikɨ, hipame 'ukarawetsixi xekaniwarutiwitɨni hipame kakaɨyarixi memɨwarayexeiya.

Hikɨ, 'ayumieme, xekeneyutahekɨata ke'axaxemɨte'uyuri Yawé ta'ukiyarima wakakaɨyari hetsɨa, hikɨ 'ana tita mɨtinake pɨta yaxeketeneyurieka. Teɨteri Kakaɨyari memɨka'ayexeiya xekeniwaruku'eiri meta mɨkɨ 'ukarawetsixi memɨkatateɨterima.
Yunaitɨ mana memɨyuxeɨriekai karima mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: —Naime kepemɨtarahɨawe yatekateniyurikuni.
Perɨtsɨ xeikɨa tepɨkayɨwawe 'ena kwiepa temɨtiteni, witarita tekaniyɨaka, 'ikɨ matsi xeitukari ya huta tukari pɨkamieme, tekanimɨireni 'ikɨ 'axamɨ'ane temeɨtiwiwiexɨa.

Mɨpaɨ tepaitɨka tame 'aixɨa katiyɨni te'aitamete memanuyetei xeikɨa memɨyuhayewa, yunaitɨ kemɨ'ane takiekaritsie memɨtitetɨka 'ukarawetsixi hipame memɨwarutiwitɨ mɨkɨ tukari ke'utipiyani kepauka memayenexɨani, 'itsɨkate mɨkɨ kiekaritsie miemete wahamatɨa me'aye'utɨ, kepaukake takakaɨyari mɨkahaxɨapieni 'axatemɨte'uyurikɨ.
Kunatani 'Atsaheri nu'aya meta Kahatsiyaxi Tikiwa nu'aya, mɨkɨ xeikɨa yamepɨkateha'eriwakai, rewitsixi mewaparewiekaku Metsurani meta Tsawetahi.

Memu'axɨakai memehapaniekai meripaitɨ yameteniuyurieni kehepaɨ memɨte'uxatakai. Hikɨ mawari wewiwame 'Etsitɨraxi kaniwaranayexeiya hipame meta kememɨtetetewakai kaniwarutiterɨwa hipame 'ukirawetsixi, muyukatsutɨatsie mexɨakame tukaritsie tamamata metseritsie mana kaniwarukuxeɨrieni para 'aixɨa mɨtiyurienikɨ mɨkɨ hepaɨtsita.
Mexɨakame tukaritsie mexɨakame metseritsie mekateniutahayewa 'aixɨa meteyurietɨ mɨkɨ yunaime wahetsiemieme 'ukarawetsixi hipame memɨwarutiwitɨxɨa wahepaɨtsita.
Kemɨ'ane wahetsie mɨrahɨiwakai
Mawari wewiwamete wanuiwarima hipame 'ukarawetsixi memɨwarutiwitɨkai 'ikɨ mekanihɨkɨtɨni:
Ketsuha Kutsaraki nu'aya, meta wa'iwama: Matsehiyaxi, 'Eriyetsexi, Kariwi meta Kerariyaxi,
mɨkɨ yameniutiyuani yu'ɨitama memɨwaku'eiriexɨanikɨ, meta xeime muxa 'ukitɨme mekaniutimawa 'axamemɨte'uyurikɨ 'itiya mawariyari mayanikɨ.
'Imexi nuiwarimama: Kananihi meta Tsewariyaxi.
Karini nuiwarimama: Matsehiyaxi, 'Eriyaxi, Tsemahiyaxi, Kehieri meta 'Utsiyaxi.
Patsuxi nuiwarimama: 'Erihuhenahi, Matsehiyaxi, 'Itsimaheri, Natanaheri, Kutsawari meta 'Eratsa.
Rewitsixi kemɨ'ane memɨyɨakai:
Kutsawari, Tsimi, Kerahiyaxi Kerita tɨtɨ mɨtitewakai, Petahiyaxi, Kura, meta 'Eriyetsexi.
Kwikamete kemɨ'ane memɨyɨakai: 'Eriyatsiwi. Kitenie tehɨwemete kemɨ'ane memɨyɨakai: Tsaruni, Tereni meta 'Urihi.
Hipatɨta meta 'ixaheritsixi kemɨ'ane memɨyɨakai:
Parutsi nuiwarimama: Xamiyaxi, Ketsiyaxi, Marikiyaxi, Mikamini, 'Eriyatsaxi, Marikiyaxi meta Wenahiyaxi.
'Erami nuiwarimama: Mataniyaxi, Tsakariyaxi, Kehieri, 'Awɨri, Keremuti meta 'Eriyaxi.
Tsatuhu nuiwarimama: 'Erihuhenahi, 'Eriyatsiwi, Mataniyaxi, Keremuti, Tsawari meta 'Atsitsa.
Wewahi nuiwarimama: Kuhanahani, Kananiyaxi, Tsawahi meta 'Atɨrahi.
Wanihi nuiwarimama: Metsurani, Maruki, 'Arahiyaxi, Yatsuwi, Tsehari meta Xamuti.
Pakati-Muhawi nuiwarimama: 'Arɨna, Kerari, Wenahiyaxi, Matsehiyaxi, Mataniyaxi, Wetsareri, Winuhi meta Manatsexi.
Karini nuiwarimama: 'Eriyetsexi, 'Itsiyaxi, Marikiyaxi, Tsemahiyaxi, Tsimehuni,
Wenikamini, Maruki meta Tsemariyaxi.
Katsuni nuiwarimama: Matenahi, Matata, Tsawari, 'Eripereti, Keremahi, Manatsexi meta Tsimi.
Wanihi nuiwarimama: Marahi, 'Amirani, 'Uheri,
Wenahiyaxi, Weriyaxi, Keruhi,
Waniyaxi, Meremuti, 'Eriyatsiwi,
Mataniyaxi, Matenahi, Katsahi.
Winuhi nuiwarimama: Tsimi,
Tseremiyaxi, Natani, 'Arahiyaxi,
Manarewahi, Tsatsahi, Tsarahi,
'Atsareri, Tseremiyaxi, Tsemariyaxi,
Tsaruni, 'Amariyaxi meta Kutse.
Newu nuiwarimama: Keyeri, Matatiyaxi, Tsawari, Tsewina, Karahu, Kuheri meta Wenahiyaxi.
'Ikɨ yunaitɨ hipame 'ukarawetsixi memɨkawateɨterimatɨkai mekaniwarutiwitɨkaitɨni, hipatɨ 'ari tɨɨri mekaniwarayexeiyaxɨakaitɨni wahetsie.
